title: Consolidation: Central European Geopolitics & Visegrád Cooperation

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can synthesize the historical evolution of Central European diplomatic coordination from the 1335 royal summit to the contemporary V4.
I can fluently apply diplomatic conditionals and polite hedging (indokolt volna, kívánatosnak tartaná, aggályosnak találná, mérlegelné).
I can debate complex geopolitical questions including energy corridors, EU sovereignty vs. federalism, and connectivity strategies.
